faq.q: Does a better smell prove that a house's air is safe?
faq.a: No. Do not treat a brief odor change or a salesperson's promise as an air-quality clearance. Get appropriate professional advice for unresolved conditions.

faq.q: Does an EPA establishment number mean an ozone machine is approved?
faq.a: No. EPA says that number identifies the production facility and does not establish that the agency found the device safe or effective.

faq.q: Should I buy an air cleaner before choosing how to sell?
faq.a: First identify the problem and compare a written preparation scope with a current-condition sale. A device is not a substitute for understanding the source or the work needed.

faq.q: Can I request a Cash As-Is evaluation before removing all tobacco odor?
faq.a: You can describe the condition and ask whether the property fits our purchase criteria. An evaluation does not guarantee a purchase, a cleanup result or a particular price.
